title: Establishing and Managing the Project Management Office (PMO)
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential knowledge to establish and manage a Project Management Office (PMO). Participants will learn how to assess their organization's project management maturity level and implement strategies for improvement. Additionally, the course focuses on tailoring a project management methodology that aligns with the specific needs and environment of the organization.
audience: This course is ideal for PMO directors and managers, members of project offices, project sponsors, functional managers, senior management, and anyone involved in the creation and management of a PMO.
methodology: The course employs a blend of interactive techniques, including concise presentations by both the consultant and participants, as well as psychometric assessments. Group exercises and case studies are integral to the course, followed by in-depth plenary discussions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Connect organizational strategy with the project management framework.
Develop a compelling business case that highlights PMO challenges and opportunities.
Assess and enhance the project management maturity level within their organization.
Draft a PMO charter and execute strategic implementation phases.
Establish a project management methodology and governance structure.
Assemble and lead a PMO team while setting and monitoring performance metrics.
Understand the PMO's role as a consultant in knowledge management.
